label: Upstream 0.82.2, with clearer failures and a leaner agent

sections.title: Upstream 0.82.1 to 0.82.2: in your app
items: No more staring at a dead end when the agent won't start. A pane that can't reach the agent now says `Couldn't connect to the agent.`, shows what went wrong, and gives you a `Try again` button right there.
The model pickers tell the truth. If the model list fails to load, both pickers say so and suggest reopening the project, instead of claiming they're still connecting.
Stopping a background task reports back. If `kill` doesn't work, you get a notice saying why, instead of a button that quietly does nothing.

sections.title: Upstream 0.82.1 to 0.82.2: in your agent
items: Every request travels lighter. `Code search` and helper agents now load only when a task needs them, so everyday requests stop carrying their full setup. They come up in only a small share of sessions, so most work starts lighter.
When you name the checks you want, the agent runs `only those`.
